messages:
marta_support: Customer filed a billing escal. They say local SDK estimator reports ~2.3k tokens but invoice shows 3.9k for the same batched request. Payload included 1) a 200-item embed batch and 2) a short generation prompt. Can we repro?

ben_engineering: Thanks — can you paste the exact payload (sanitized) and SDK version + headers? Also need the invoice line items + request id if available.

marta_support: sending a sanitized curl repro (note: customer used JS SDK v1.2.3, but they also tried curl):

```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -H "X-Client-Estimator: js-1.2.3" \ 
  -d '{\n    "requests": [\n      {"type":"embed","text":"Olá 👋 — user@example.com"},\n      {"type":"generate","prompt":"Summarize the above"}\n    ]\n  }' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch
```

marta_support: invoice line shows 3,912 tokens, request log (req_id=rx-99a) matches that call. SDK local estimator gave 2,310.

ben_engineering: preliminary findings from log rx-99a: gateway applied two server-side transforms we don't mirror in the client estimator: 1) Unicode normalization (NFKC) + emoji expansion on the embed text, which increased codepoint sequences, and 2) a conditional safety transform that inserts a short hidden system message when PII-like tokens are detected (we add a small JSON metadata tuple for downstream safety/rerank). Both increase token count but are not visible to client.

ben_engineering: quick repro steps I ran locally:
```python
# pseudocode using our tokenizer binary used in metering
from redwood_tokenizer import count_tokens
raw = "Olá 👋 — user@example.com"
normalized = normalize_nfkc(raw)  # gateway does this
expanded = expand_emoji_sequences(normalized)  # turns single pictograph into multiple codepoints in some cases
# server also prepends: 
server_prefix = '{"_sys":"safety:metadata","level":"soft"}'
combined = server_prefix + "\n" + expanded
count_tokens(raw), count_tokens(combined)
```

ben_engineering: results: raw=8 tokens, combined=26 tokens for this little example. For 200 embed items with mixed emoji/diacritics the delta compounds quickly.

sara_devex: this is why SDK estimator historically undercounts for customers who send non-ascii-heavy payloads or emails. Our estimator runs a fast tokenizer and DOES NOT perform Unicode normalization nor run the same safety heuristics that gateway uses. We should either: (A) make the estimator apply the same normalization + safety pre-checks, or (B) expose an endpoint/header so clients can opt into server-side exact-tally before charging.

marta_support: the customer is pushing back hard — they had no visibility that gateway would insert anything. Any short-term mitigation? Can we offer invoice adjustment while we fix estimator parity?

ben_engineering: short-term: we can 1) repro and validate the exact delta for rx-99a and offer a goodwill credit (I can compute exact token delta), 2) add a support doc explaining normalization/safety transforms, and 3) add a temporary flag to the gateway to suppress the safety metadata injection for accounts on a support playbook (only available after an internal review). Longer-term: update estimator to run NFKC and the same safety-detection heuristics.

jules_support: filed INC-123456 and customer notified. Pending engineering delta calc and credit approval.

ben_engineering: action items: 1) I'll push a canary that logs the exact pre/post token counts and emits a per-request breakdown (no PII in logs) — ETA 24h. 2) We'll add an option to run estimator normalization on the client side (patch to js-estimator v1.2.4) — ETA 72h. 3) I'll compute token delta for rx-99a and post amounts here.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: gateway/ingress v2.14.1-canary (logs: gateway-logs/rx-99a-dryrun)

ben_engineering: delta for rx-99a: invoice 3,912 vs client 2,310 => 1,602 extra tokens. After looking at breakdown: ~1,200 tokens from expanded embed batch (emoji + NFKC expansion on diacritics) and ~400 tokens from the safety metadata JSON that got prepended to each tool call. I'll propose a one-time credit of 1,602 tokens equivalent while we ship estimator parity.

sara_devex: workaround for customers today: run a local normalization step before estimating:
```js
// pseudo JS normalizer
const normalized = input.normalize('NFKC');
// run estimator on normalized
```
Note: this won't include safety metadata insertion, only normalization parity.

marta_support: customer accepted a credit pending billing approval, wants SDK patch. Marking this thread resolved for now; will reopen if they see more discrepancies.

jules_support: closing INC-123456 after credit processed. Will link to the new support doc once published.

deploy-bot: canary finished: gateway/ingress v2.14.1-canary -> healthy. Logs: gateway-logs/rx-99a-dryrun available for audit.
